title: Family membership enquiry
context: A telephone-style conversation at a sports centre. A customer asks a receptionist about a family membership and the receptionist completes the enquiry form.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Riverside Sports Centre. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello. I'd like some information about family membership, please. My wife and I have two children, and we'd like to swim together at weekends.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Of course. I'll take a few details so I can fill in the enquiry form. First, can I have your family name?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's Okafor. O-K-A-F-O-R.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Thank you. And what's the best contact number for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's zero seven seven zero zero nine zero zero one five two. That's my mobile, so it's the best one to ring during the day.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Got it. And how many children will be joining?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two. Our daughter is nine and our son is six. Both of them can swim a little, but they're not very confident yet.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: That's no problem. We have lessons for every level. The family package covers two adults and up to three children under sixteen, so you're well within that. Which day would suit you for swimming?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Saturday would be best, because the children don't have school. Is there a quieter time in the day?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: The pool is quietest early in the morning. Most families arrive just before the first lesson. What time would you normally arrive?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We'd aim for half past seven, so we can be in the water by eight.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Half past seven is a good time for a quiet session. The monthly fee for the family package is eighty-four pounds. That includes unlimited swimming and gym access for both adults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's reasonable. Does it include lessons for the children?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Lessons are an extra, so the fee only covers access. But I can add the children's course at a reduced rate if you'd like it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let's leave that for now. When could we start?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Membership can start on the first of September. If you join before then, the first week is free.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The first of September is perfect. Can we also choose a locker?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Yes, lockers are assigned by number. Which one would you like?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Locker twenty-two, if it's free. It's near the family changing room, which is handy with two children.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Let me check. Yes, twenty-two is available. Now, how would you like to pay?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'd prefer to pay by direct debit, so the money comes out automatically each month.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: No problem. One last question: is there any medical condition we should know about for anyone in the family?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our son has asthma. He carries an inhaler, and I'd like the lifeguards to know about it.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Thank you, I'll note that on the record, and the lifeguards will be informed. Is there anything else I can help you with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thanks very much.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: You're welcome. We'll send you a confirmation by email this evening.
